# telnyx_number_order_phone_number_update (Action)

Updates the regulatory requirements of a phone number in a number order.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `number_order_phone_number_id` (String) The number order phone number id.

### Optional

- `regulatory_requirements` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regulatory_requirements))

<a id="nestedatt--regulatory_requirements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regulatory_requirements`

Optional:

- `field_value` (String) The value of the requirement. For address and document requirements, this should be the ID of the resource. For textual, this should be the value of the requirement.
- `requirement_id` (String) Unique id for a requirement.
